common.comingSoon: Not available in this build yet (planned for a later milestone).
common.nothingToRevert: Nothing to revert: this change is not applied.
common.buildDependent: The effect depends on the Windows build and may be negligible on your system.

home.title: Home
home.subtitle: System overview and one-click presets. Every change is previewed before it is applied and can be reverted.
home.noticeTitle: This build makes no system changes
home.notice: This is the UI foundation (milestone 1). Registry access, backups and presets are implemented in later milestones.
home.sysMore: CPU topology (P/E cores, CCD, L3 groups) and GPU vendor detection arrive in a later milestone.
home.presetSafeDesc: Only the most conservative tweaks. Recommended for the first run.
home.presetBalancedDesc: A reasonable set of low-risk tweaks for competitive play.
home.presetMaxDesc: Everything supported, including medium-risk tweaks. Review the diff carefully.

kernel.subtitle: Kernel and timer registry values (restart required).
kernel.notice: The card below is a non-functional sample that shows the final tweak card layout. Nothing is written to the registry.

sample.title: Sample tweak card
sample.desc: One-line description of what this tweak changes.
sample.detail: The expanded section explains the registry path, the value being written, why it may help, and how to revert it.

affinity.subtitle: Automatically place the game and background processes on suitable CPU cores.
affinity.desc: Planned (milestone 5): CPU topology detection, game profiles, automatic apply/restore. Note: some anti-cheat software may warn about or block affinity changes. The benefit is small on simple CPU layouts.

usb.subtitle: USB selective suspend and related power settings.
usb.desc: Planned (milestone 6): uses the documented Windows power-setting API only, with the previous values backed up.

gpu.subtitle: Documented NVIDIA settings.
gpu.desc: Planned (milestone 6): this page is disabled when no NVIDIA GPU is detected.

bench.subtitle: Compare timer resolution and sleep accuracy before and after.
bench.desc: Planned (milestone 7): results are system-dependent and are saved as JSON.

backup.subtitle: Change history, restore points and full revert.
backup.desc: Planned (milestones 2–3): per-tweak restore, restore all, and “revert everything and exit”.

log.subtitle: Operation log with filter, copy and export.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, language and resource usage.
settings.noJpFont: No Japanese system font was found, so Japanese text may not display correctly.
settings.reduceMotionDesc: Turns off all UI animations. The window then redraws only when you interact with it.
settings.aboutText: LatencyForge 0.1.0 — MIT License. Fully offline: no telemetry, no auto-update, no network access.
